It is weakened by using 1500 °C—far above typical hot-dip aluminizing temperatures—and by extrapolating oxidation data to molten-Al corrosion, but A is less physically sound because simple oxidation of an unspecified boride cannot form Al2O3 without an aluminum source and its claimed 30–50% benefit is unsupported.
